optimization_strategy.bottleneck: [memory/overhead-bound composite] Every profiled custom kernel is already at DRAM roofline (gn_apply_transpose 112.9us @89.9% DRAM=1586GB/s; gn_apply_nhwc 85.9%; nchw_to_nhwc 84.8%; gn_stats 88.3%), and the two cutlass TF32 convs run at ~95% of FP32/TF32 peak (~1.55ms). The only unexploited cost is ~80us/forward of fixed, zero-math per-call work: 2 ATen weight-permute copies + 4 cuDNN convertTensor launches per forward.
optimization_strategy.primary_optimisation_method: Redundant-work elimination via a persistent channels_last weight cache: hoist the per-call `w.contiguous(ChannelsLast)` conversions of the two 256x256x3x3 filters out of the forward path by memoising them keyed on data_ptr/version. This is a provably equivalent rewrite (E2): the weights are identical tensors on every call, so the 2.36MB strided permute copies (nsys: 24 elementwise_kernel = 2/forward) and their DRAM traffic are pure repeated work. It is the only lever left because all real kernels sit at 85-90% DRAM SOL (<=11us headroom each).
optimization_strategy.evidence: gn_apply_transpose_kernel = 112.9us at gpu__dram_throughput 89.9% (1586 GB/s of 1792) and sm__throughput 21.8% -> intra-kernel headroom <= 11us; gn_apply_nhwc 70.6us @85.9%, nchw_to_nhwc 70.7us @84.8%, gn_stats 47.9us @88.3% — all DRAM-roofline, all moving the minimum 9 tensor-units (603MB) required by the NHWC conv dataflow. Convs: 2x77.3 GFLOP at ~104 TFLOPS ~= 1.5ms ~= 95% of TF32 peak. Root cause of the remaining gap: 1942us(measured) - 1550us(conv) - 310us(custom kernels) ~= 80us/forward of no-math work, matching nsys's 24 elementwise_kernel (2 weight permutes of 2.36MB each) + 48 convertTensor launches. Refutation of the alternative 'vectorize/re-tile gn_stats': it already sustains 1535 GB/s (87% of peak), so even a perfect rewrite saves <=10us per call (<1%), an order of magnitude below eliminating fixed per-call weight conversion, which is ~10% of the 294us small-shape time.
optimization_strategy.expected_metric_change: (1) nsys per-forward launch count 15 -> 13 custom/vendor kernels; at::native::elementwise_kernel launches 24 -> 0. (2) Wall-clock per forward down ~25-60us on 8x256x64x128 (1.942ms -> ~1.89-1.92ms) and ~8-10% on 2x256x64x64 (0.294ms -> ~0.27ms), lifting the geometric mean ~3%. (3) Anti-regression constraints: gn_apply_transpose / gn_apply_nhwc / gn_stats durations and gpu__dram_throughput (>=85% of peak) must be unchanged; max_atol must stay <= 0.0027-0.0030 per shape (outputs should be bit-identical); extra persistent device memory <= 8MB; the 1x256x131x131 (H*W odd) shape must remain correct because nblk/chunk derivation is untouched.
